about: What the logging standard's check (logs.mjs, AHT-204) doesn't hold: upstream code and the standard's own implementation. paths are globs in the repository; an entry without paths exempts the repository whole, and homesvc doesn't check its images' lines either (at-home-tools docs/app-logs.md, Enforcement). Every entry says why.

exemptions.reason: The standard's own implementation: it writes the line by hand, so every other program doesn't.
A fork of spotify-player: its tracing and env_logger set-up, and its log file, are upstream's.
Rio's own tracing and env_logger (upstream, the terminal's fork); at-terminal's own log is frontends/rioterm/src/atlog.rs, on logline.
A hand-run desktop test, whose log is its own report for the person running it.
tmux's regression tests, whose logs are each test's own output.
log-ship and homesvc copy other programs' lines into the pile's day files; they write no line of their own there.
A Terraform provider's stderr is read by tofu as the plugin's log, never shipped.

Core logs through the game's own logger into its godot.log; the console fallback runs only where there is no game (Core's tests and offline tools), whose console is their output.
Codex's hooks; Codex is out of scope for home work (shell-config-profile-home CLAUDE.md).
